svg.title: Estimated lid-closed current draw: about 250 mA for 0.3.0 (semi-stock) software standby, 105 mA for the first suspend-to-RAM test, 70 mA for the 0.4.0 configuration
svg.desc: Horizontal bar chart of currents calculated from battery-gauge readings, one run each. 0.3.0 (semi-stock) software standby, a modified build held awake: about 250 mA, bounded 248 to 253 by when each 1% tick fell. First suspend-to-RAM test (10 October 2026, before 0.4.0; test-a-suspend-usb-wifi-on.txt) with USB and the Wi-Fi radio left powered: about 105 mA, 87.5 to 122.5 from whole-percent gauge resolution. 0.4.0 configuration, from a 1.5-hour run below 80% charge: about 70 mA, 69.6 to 75.4 from the awake current assumed in the correction method (240 to 260 mA). None of the ranges is a confidence interval. The extended sleeps started above 80% charge, where the gauge's step size is not known, so they are not converted to a current. About 72% less than software standby.

g.text: Calculated from battery-gauge readings, not measured with test equipment
First suspend-to-RAM testUSB and Wi-Fi radio left powered
Whiskers differ by run, and none is a confidence interval. 0.3.0: when each 1%
tick fell. First suspend test: whole-percent gauge resolution. 0.4.0 configuration:
the assumed awake current (240 to 260 mA) in the correction method. One run each.
Extended sleeps started above 80%, where step sizes are unknown: no current.
